source_text: Direct analyses are to be carried out using the load patch defined in section 4.2 (p, h and la). The pressure to be used is 1.8p where p is determined according to 4.2.2. The load patch must be applied at locations where the capacity of the structure under the combined effects of bending and shear is minimised. In particular, the structure must be checked with a load centred at the UIWL, 0.5h0 below the LIWL, and positioned at several vertical locations in between. Several horizontal locations shall also be checked, especially the locations centred at the mid-span or -spacing. Furthermore, if the load length la cannot be determined directly from the arrangement of the structure, several values of la shall be checked using corresponding values for ca.
